fact: The minister said 13,991 km of the national backbone were built, connecting 109 of 139 districts, with 30 more being worked on in 2024/25 and a 15,000 km target by June 2025; the Horohoro link to the Mombasa submarine cables was completed in January 2025.
title: Utekelezaji wa mradi wa kuunganisha Mkongo wa Taifa wa Mawasiliano na mikongo ya baharini katika pwani ya Mombasa nchini Kenya wakamilika
